options.description: Sets the duration of the identification procedure in seconds (i.e., how long the device would flash).The value ranges from 1 to 30 seconds (default: 3).
options.label: Identify timeout
options.name: identify_timeout

options.description: State actions will also be published as 'action' when true (default false).
options.label: State action
options.name: state_action
